keyPoints.en: He – for a boy or man; She – for a girl or woman
keyPoints.hi: He – लड़के या आदमी के लिए; She – लड़की या औरत के लिए

keyPoints.en: It – for an animal or thing
keyPoints.hi: It – जानवर या चीज़ के लिए

keyPoints.en: I, we (ourselves); you; they (many people or things)
keyPoints.hi: I, we (हम ख़ुद); you; they (कई लोग या चीज़ें)

problem.en: Replace the noun: "Sita is my sister. Sita is five."
problem.hi: संज्ञा बदलो: "Sita is my sister. Sita is five."

steps.en: Sita is a girl, so use "She".

answer.en: Sita is my sister. She is five.
answer.hi: Sita is my sister. She is five.

problem.en: Fill in: "The kite is red. __ is flying high."
problem.hi: भरो: "The kite is red. __ is flying high."

steps.en: A kite is a thing, so use "It".

question.en: Fill in: "Rahul and Asha are friends. __ play together."
question.hi: भरो: "Rahul and Asha are friends. __ play together."

question.en: Which pronoun for your grandfather: he or she?
question.hi: दादाजी के लिए कौन-सा सर्वनाम: he या she?

question.en: Fill in: "My friends and I like cricket. __ play every Sunday."
question.hi: भरो: "My friends and I like cricket. __ play every Sunday."

intro.en: Pronouns take the place of nouns so we don't repeat names. "Ravi is kind. Ravi helps me." becomes "Ravi is kind. He helps me."
intro.hi: सर्वनाम (pronoun) संज्ञा की जगह आते हैं ताकि नाम बार-बार न दोहराएँ। "Ravi is kind. Ravi helps me." बन जाता है "Ravi is kind. He helps me."
